product.name: Monoprice BT-300ANC Bluetooth Wireless Over Ear Headphones with Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) and Qualcomm aptX Audio
product.description: Monoprice™BT‑300ANC Over Ear Active Noise Cancelling HeadphonesEveryday wireless headphone for at home, at work, or travelThe Monoprice™ BT‑300ANC Over Ear Active Noise Cancelling Headphones are great everyday wireless headphones for use at home, at work, or while traveling. Featuring a foldable, extremely portable design, 40mm drivers, and active noise cancelling technology, the BT‑300ANC utilizes Bluetooth® wireless technology to connect with your mobile device at distances up to 32 feet away. Experience exceptional sound quality, comfort, and design with the Monoprice BT‑300ANC Over Ear Active Noise Cancelling Headphones.Bluetooth® 5.0 wireless connectionSupports the Qualcomm® aptX™ Audio, SBC, and AAC audio codecsUSB-Type C® charging port40mm driversUp to 19 hours playback time without ANCUp to 12 hours playback time with ANC BLUETOOTH® 5.0 WIRELESS TECHNOLOGYConnect your Bluetooth® enabled device at distances up to 32 feet (10 meters). Qualcomm® CSR technology delivers crystal clear sound, extends battery life, and provides an easy and solid connection to your phone, tablet, or other device. ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATIONEngage Active Noise Cancellation to block outside noise, such as an airplane engine or other background noise. The external microphones "listen" to the environment and then generate a reverse phase signal that eliminates background noise and lets the music take center stage. MAXIMUM COMFORT. FOLDABLE. PORTABLE.These headphones feature a foldable, highly portable design. Plush, soft earpads, an adjustable, padded headband, and a soft touch texture make these headphones an easy companion while on the go. EXTENDED PLAYTIMEExperience up to 16 hours of playtime or 18 hours of talk time. Don't miss a call! You can answer incoming calls with your headphones and your music will automatically resume when the call is finished. CRYSTAL CLEAR CALLS WITH CVC™ 6.0Qualcomm® cVc™ noise cancellation technology brings advanced audio enhancements and noise suppression techniques to reduce background, ambient noise and make phone calls sound crystal clear. Use the controls on the left earpiece to adjust the volume, skip tracks, or for hands-free phone calls. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x BT‑300ANC Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) Bluetooth® Headphones • 1x USB Type‑C® Charging Cable • 1x 3.5mm Audio Cable • 1x Carrying Case • 1x User's Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
